name: Hung Sheng Construction Ltd
summary: Hung Sheng Construction Co., Ltd. engages in commission of contractors to build public housing for sale and rental. It operates through the following segments: Sales of Real Estate, Construction, and Lease. The Sale of Real Estate segment is involved in selling residences and commercial buildings. The Construction segment includes building of residences and commercial buildings. The Lease segment focuses on investment property. The company was founded on July 9, 1986 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
